source.title: Searching with iterated maps
source.pages: Publisher cover followed by article pages 418–423
source.review_scope: Main article text read, including difference-map formula, strange-attractor interpretation, all application sections and conclusions; Figure 3 inspected as a schematic. Supplementary information not reviewed. Third-party full text is not redistributed.
source.finding: Projection/difference-map search chaos and circle-product Fourier constraints are established. The protein-folding circle is a schematic for a high-dimensional covalent-geometry constraint, not a study of two spatial circumferences. The article does not establish priority for the present exact RAAR pair. This is not an inequivalence proof.

outcome: No exact match located in this bounded review. Neither historical uniqueness nor a new attractor class is established.
